about_the_game:
In this retro-inspired, pixel art visual novel, a workplace friendship begins to unravel.            

Follow two coworkers as their connection deepens, blurs, and ultimately breaks. Set during a painful chapter of life, Messy Hearts explores mental health, trauma, blurry boundaries, and the complicated ways people can hurt each other.

                                                       

Florence and Their Messy Life

You play as Florence, a game dev, parent, and lonely person trying to stay afloat in a life already full of stress and vulnerability.

When Pete, a married coworker, starts offering unexpected friendship, Florence finds comfort in their growing connection. Their friendship slowly twists into something painful and disorienting, and a slow-motion collision unfolds that they both pretend not to see coming.

This is an all-too-common story, told through fictional characters, and inspired by painful relationships.

                                                 

                   

How to Play

Messy Hearts is a linear, single-player narrative with no branching paths or choices. Told in a comic book-style format with pixel art, the game invites players to click through Florence’s memories like pages of a journal, a text thread, or a conversation snippet.

There are no quick-time events, puzzles, or branching choices for this game. Just a quiet, interactive story, day by day, scene by scene, and message by message.

content_descriptors.notes: Themes of mental health issues and trauma.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ or equivalent
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2 compatible GPU (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Should work on most modern 64-bit Linux systems.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra+
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or later)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Runs on most modern systems — very lightweight.

short_description: Messy Hearts is a pixel-art visual novel about a complicated coworker friendship. Through journal-style narration, Florence unpacks romance, trauma, and some messy boundaries in a deeply personal story of mental health and heartbreak. No choices; this is a linear narrative.
